description:
At Marathon Supply, we pride ourselves on being the people's supplier for all their apparel decoration needs. From custom DTF transfers to heat transfer vinyl and screen printing equipment, we offer a wide range of high-quality products and services at affordable prices. We believe that everyone should have access to the tools they need to create beautiful, personalized apparel, which is why we are committed to providing exceptional customer service and support. Whether you're a small business owner or an individual looking to create a unique design, Marathon Supply is here to help you every step of the way.

At Marathon Supply, we also believe that our affiliates are not just affiliates, but partners. As we grow, our partners grow, which is why we offer an industry-leading 90-day cookie. Our commission grows in tiers, providing our partners with the opportunity to earn more as they grow. We are committed to supporting our partners every step of the way and helping them achieve success.

Our Custom DTF Transfers are high-quality and long-lasting, providing exceptional results for our customers. Our Heat Transfer Vinyl comes in a variety of colors and finishes, perfect for creating unique designs. Our Heat Presses are easy to use and reliable, ensuring that our customers get the best possible results. Our Screen Printing Ink & Supplies and Screen Printing Equipment are of the highest quality and designed for maximum efficiency. We also offer Art services to help our customers create the perfect design for their apparel.

Payment Terms: Our payment terms are straightforward and easy to understand. We offer competitive commission rates, with payments made on a monthly basis. Our partners can choose to receive their payments via PayPal or bank transfer. We believe in transparency and honesty in all our business dealings, which is why we provide detailed reporting on all sales and commissions.
